steps.name: подготовка
steps.js: document.querySelector('.title .btn').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); FB.ui.closeAll(); const S = FB.S; S.tut = 99; S.tips = { chip: 1, profile: 1, bait: 1, bubbles: 1 }; S.stats.catches = 12; S.owned.push('bt_rowboat', 'bt_yacht', 'bt_raft'); S.look.boat = 'bt_rowboat'; S.look.pet = 'pet_none'; FB.scene.setPlace('village', 'sun'); FB.hud.update(); return S.look.boat;

steps.name: находка
steps.js: const D = FB.drift; D.update(0); D.item = { kind: 'bottle', tx: 0.45, end: -0.5, dist: 0.35, v: -0.04, t: 1.5, got: false, gotT: 0 }; return D.pos();

steps.name: забрать
steps.js: const p = FB.drift.pos(); const o = { clientX: p.x, clientY: p.y - p.r * 0.4, bubbles: true, pointerId: 1 }; document.getElementById('game').dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', o)); window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', o)); return [FB.fishing.phase, FB.S.coins, FB.S.tips.drift];

steps.name: яхта и ракушка
steps.js: FB.S.look.boat = 'bt_yacht'; FB.drift.item = { kind: 'shell', tx: 0.3, end: -0.5, dist: 0.3, v: -0.04, t: 1.5, got: false, gotT: 0 };

steps.name: магазин: лодки
steps.js: FB.S.tips.shop = 1; FB.S.tips.rods = 1; FB.shopUI.open('look'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); document.querySelectorAll('.sheet .tabs')[1].querySelectorAll('.tab')[4].click();

steps.name: сезон
steps.js: document.querySelector('.coach .btn').click(); FB.ui.closeAll(); FB.S.season.pass = true; FB.S.season.pts = 1300; FB.tasks.open('season');

steps.name: уровень
steps.js: FB.ui.closeAll(); FB.S.tips.profile = 0; delete FB.S.tips.profile; FB.S.xp = 200; FB.S.level = FB.state.levelFromXp(200); FB.hud.update();
